verdict.rationale: The Sai REST API exposes version-prefixed endpoints (/v1/agents/...), which shows basic API versioning. The only deprecation evidence is a single legacy surface marked deprecated and kept for migration, which is a notice rather than a documented deprecation policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (timelines, notice periods, sunset process), a versioning or changelog policy, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: `GET /v1/agents/events` streams progress; `POST /v1/agents/approve` answers an approval request
Legacy in-app JavaScript-style actions for a deprecated desktop automation surface. Kept for reference and migration only.
